name: monitor_log_level
label: &Logs::level_label
desc: lowest level the monitor port carries
notes: open by default: this port exists to be the full record

name: mqtt_level
label: &Logs::level_label
desc: lowest level published to the broker
notes: every entry costs a publish, so this is the floor to raise first

name: home_log_level
label: &Logs::level_label
desc: lowest level HOME's log tail shows
notes: a landing screen: only what is worth looking up for

name: shell_log_level
label: &Logs::level_label
desc: lowest level the SHELL page interleaves
notes: `logs off` silences it entirely without moving this

name: logs_log_level
label: &Logs::level_label
desc: lowest level the LOGS page keeps
notes: this page is the record; raising it loses the record
